Claim_Text: CO2 utilisation supports global efforts to achieve net-zero emissions and increase possibilities of continued use of fossil fuels such as coal, petroleum and natural gas.
Supporting_Source: None (Author assertion in original draft)
Conflicting_Evidence: Thermodynamic and LCA laws: Converting combustion CO2 back to fuels requires 4-6x the energy generated by fossil combustion. CCU cannot justify continued fossil extraction; it is a circular carbon solution for hard-to-abate sectors.
Required_Action: PURGE AND REWRITE: Explicitly refute the fossil-continuation fallacy and frame CCU as a tool for circular carbon economy and residual emissions.

Conflicting_Evidence: Global fossil CO2 emissions reached 36.8 Gt in 2023 and estimated 37.4 Gt in 2024.
Required_Action: RETAIN with accurate citation to IEA 2024 and GCP 2024.

Claim_Text: The high thermodynamic stability of CO2 (dG0f = -394.4 kJ/mol) makes its activation kinetically challenging.

Conflicting_Evidence: Standard Gibbs free energy of formation is -394.39 kJ/mol; C=O bond dissociation energy is ~750 kJ/mol (total atomization energy ~1608 kJ/mol).
Required_Action: RETAIN and integrate into thermodynamic activation landscape.

Conflicting_Evidence: Mammoth became operational in May 2024 in Hellisheidi, Iceland, NOT in 2026. Design capacity is 36,000 t/yr.

Supporting_Source: Oxylus Energy Technical Whitepaper / Pilot Specifications

Claim_Text: Methanol reaction: CO2 + 3H2 -> CH3OH + H2O (dH = -49 kJ/mol) using Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 at 200-300 °C, 20-100 bar.
Supporting_Source: Goeppert et al. (2014) Chem. Soc. Rev.; Behrens et al. (2012) Science
Conflicting_Evidence: Reaction stoichiometry and baseline enthalpy are correct; original manuscript omitted competing RWGS equilibrium (+41.2 kJ/mol) and 2020-2025 vacancy-engineered In2O3/ZrO2 catalysts.
Required_Action: RETAIN baseline; expand to incorporate RWGS thermodynamic selectivity trade-off and In2O3 100% selectivity benchmark.

Claim_Text: Urea reaction: 2NH3 + CO2 -> NH4NH2COO -> CO(NH2)2 + H2O at 140-175 bar.
Supporting_Source: Meessen (2012) Ullmann Industrial Chemistry; Ke et al. (2025)
Conflicting_Evidence: Chemical formula typo: written as NH4NH2COO instead of ammonium carbamate NH2COONH4; original text omitted the crucial fact that agricultural urea releases 100% of incorporated CO2 upon soil application.
Required_Action: CORRECT formula to NH2COONH4; document two-step thermodynamics and explicitly state the 100% agricultural carbon emission fate.

Claim_Text: Solid CO2 can be utilized by using burning Mg ribbon to produce graphene... Bagotia et al. (2018b) used Ni and Zn promoters.
Supporting_Source: Bagotia et al. (2018a/b) Polymer Composites; Chakrabarti et al. (2011) J. Mater. Chem.
Conflicting_Evidence: Magnesiothermic combustion yields disordered graphitic flakes and soot mixed with MgO. Crucially, upstream smelting of metallic Mg emits 15-25 kg CO2e/kg Mg (+21 kg CO2e net emissions per kg CO2 consumed), destroying all climate claims.
Required_Action: REWRITE section to provide scientific mass/LCA balance of Mg reduction; introduce molten carbonate electrolysis (C2CNT) as the true sustainable electrochemical route.

Claim_Text: Grignard Carboxylation: R-MgX + CO2 - R-COOH has high atom economy.
Supporting_Source: Standard Organic Synthesis Textbooks; Liu et al. (2015)
Conflicting_Evidence: Grignard carboxylation is stoichiometric, not catalytic. It requires a mandatory acidic quench: R-COOMgX + HCl -> R-COOH + MgXCl, generating stoichiometric hazardous metal salts (E-factor > 25). It does NOT have high atom economy.
Required_Action: CORRECT reaction to two-step stoichiometric equation; introduce visible-light photoredox C-H carboxylation (König et al. 2021) as the true catalytic, high atom-economy modern route.

Claim_Text: Supercritical CO2 (scCO2) above 31.1 °C and 73.8 bar is a dual solvent, both liquid and gas.
Supporting_Source: IUPAC Compendium of Chemical Terminology (Gold Book)
Conflicting_Evidence: A supercritical fluid is a single, homogeneous thermodynamic phase above its critical temperature and pressure where liquid and gas are indistinguishable. It is NOT both a liquid and a gas simultaneously.
Required_Action: CORRECT definition to match IUPAC physical thermodynamic standards.

Claim_Text: Mineralization: CO2 + waste (fly ash, slag) yields green concrete/aggregates which provides long-term carbon storage.
Supporting_Source: Dhawan et al. (2020); Sanna et al. (2021); Snæbjörnsdóttir et al. (2020)
Conflicting_Evidence: Original manuscript text was only two superficial sentences; lacked chemical reactions, dissolution kinetics, and distinction between in-situ basalt trapping and ex-situ slag curing.
Required_Action: EXPAND section with balanced equations (Ca(OH)2, CaSiO3), kinetics, Carbfix 2-year verification (>95% mineralized), and concrete curing clinker displacement.

Claim_Text: In 2026 the CCU market will reach USD 6.45 million and reach USD 20.4 billion at a CAGR of 13.5 by 2035.

Conflicting_Evidence: USD 6.45 million in 2026 is an egregious unit transcription typo for USD 6.45 billion. The physical CCU market is measured in billions of USD, not millions.
Required_Action: CORRECT typo: replace million with billion (USD 6.45 billion in 2026 to USD 20.4 billion by 2035).

Claim_Text: In2O3-based catalysts achieve 100% methanol selectivity at 300 °C and 5 MPa, completely suppressing the RWGS reaction.

Required_Action: FEATURE in Section 6 as modern alternative to sintering-prone Cu/ZnO catalysts.

Claim_Text: Carbonate crossover in alkaline/neutral electrochemical CO2 reduction wastes 50-70% of inlet CO2 via reaction with electrogenerated OH-.
Supporting_Source: Rabinowitz & Kanan (2020) Nature Comm.; Seger et al. (2021) Nature Energy
Conflicting_Evidence: CO2 + 2OH- -> CO3(2-) + H2O. Transport of CO3(2-) across anion exchange membranes releases CO2 mixed with O2 at the anode, creating severe parasitic separation energy penalties.
Required_Action: INTEGRATE into Section 8 as a primary thermodynamic and engineering research gap.

Claim_Text: Pongamia pinnata seed oil cracking to multi-walled carbon nanotubes is a direct CO2 utilisation pathway.

Required_Action: EXPLICITLY CLARIFY in Section 11 that Pongamia oil is a biomass-derived precursor and must not be conflated with direct CO2 conversion.
